rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for MINE ACTION ACTORS
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेजको द्रुत सुरुवात मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: Quick start guide to the MHPSS minimum service package for actors involved in mine action

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for MINE ACTION ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed clinical composite T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमूहको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकता पूरा गर्न प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of populations affected by emergencies.
rows.note: The clinical composite is reused from the supplied unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य पीडा कम गर्न र मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण सुधार गर्न योगदान पुर्‍याउनु हो।
rows.bt: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The clinical phrase is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity candidate T100; psychosocial well-being also matches T005.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका कार्यक्रमहरूका सन्दर्भमा यो कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant in the context of mine action programmes?

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: Survivors of explosive ordnance (EO) related incidents may have a range of MHPSS needs associated with their injuries.
rows.ne: विस्फोटक आयुध (EO) सम्बन्धी घटनामा बाँचेका व्यक्तिहरूका चोटपटकसँग सम्बन्धित विभिन्न MHPSS आवश्यकता हुन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: People who have survived incidents involving explosive ordnance (EO) may have various MHPSS needs related to their injuries.
rows.note: Proposes explosive ordnance = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. Injuries and incident survivors are translated as ordinary descriptive wording, without introducing a diagnosis.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: They may experience chronic pain, phantom pain, diminished independence, restricted access to activities, problems with self-image, and social challenges such as unemployment, changes to social roles, stigma, discrimination, and increased socio-economic vulnerability.
rows.ne: उनीहरूले दीर्घकालीन दुखाइ, फ्यान्टम दुखाइ (phantom pain), स्वतन्त्रतामा कमी, गतिविधिहरूमा सीमित पहुँच, आफ्नो छविसम्बन्धी समस्याहरू तथा बेरोजगारी, सामाजिक भूमिकामा परिवर्तन, लाञ्छना, भेदभाव र सामाजिक-आर्थिक जोखिमप्रवणतामा वृद्धि जस्ता सामाजिक चुनौतीहरू अनुभव गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: They may experience long-term pain, phantom pain (phantom pain), reduced independence, limited access to activities, problems related to their own image, and social challenges such as unemployment, changes in social roles, stigma, discrimination and increased socioeconomic vulnerability.
rows.note: The symptom wording is an unvalidated draft; no supplied candidate covers phantom pain, which retains English at first use. The source specifies increased socio-economic vulnerability, whereas the Nepali and BT express increased socio-economic insecurity. Repaired this distinction while retaining possibility.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: The UN Policy on Victim Assistance in Mine Action and the International Mine Action Standards (IMAS 13.10) include ‘psychological and psychosocial support’ as one of six key components of victim assistance.
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा पीडित सहायतासम्बन्धी UN को नीति तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य मापदण्डहरू (IMAS 13.10) ले पीडित सहायताका छ वटा प्रमुख घटकहरूमध्ये एकका रूपमा ‘मनोवैज्ञानिक र मनोसामाजिक सहयोग’ समावेश गरेका छन्।
rows.bt: The UN policy on victim assistance in mine action and the International Mine Action Standards (IMAS 13.10) have included ‘psychological and psychosocial support’ as one of the six main components of victim assistance.
rows.note: Both psychological and psychosocial support, the count of six, UN and IMAS 13.10 are retained.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: Activities to prevent injuries and reduce risks can be opportunities to integrate MHPSS, for example, by incorporating key messages on MHPSS as part of explosive ordnance risk education (EORE).
rows.ne: चोटपटक रोक्ने र जोखिम घटाउने गतिविधिहरू MHPSS एकीकृत गर्ने अवसर हुन सक्छन्, उदाहरणका लागि, विस्फोटक आयुधको जोखिमसम्बन्धी शिक्षा (EORE) को अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी मुख्य सन्देशहरू समावेश गरेर।
rows.bt: Activities to prevent injuries and reduce risk can be opportunities to integrate MHPSS, for example, by including key messages about MHPSS as part of explosive ordnance risk education (EORE).
rows.note: General injury-prevention and risk-reduction guidance; safety review pending. Uses the proposed term explosive ordnance = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities that Mine Action actors can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of survivors of EO related incidents and those at risk of being injured.
rows.ne: MSP ले EO सम्बन्धी घटनामा बाँचेका व्यक्ति र चोटपटक लाग्ने जोखिममा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूले कार्यान्वयन गर्न र सहयोग पुर्‍याउन सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities that actors involved in mine action can implement and support to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people who have survived EO-related incidents and people at risk of injury.
rows.note: EO retains the acronym for the proposed missing term explosive ordnance. The clinical promotion phrase is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity candidate T100.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Mine Action programming?
rows.en: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्ने?
rows.bt: How can mine action material be found in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्र (AoRs) त्यसलाई सञ्चालन गर्न (रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरू) वा त्यसमा योगदान गर्न (गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नहरू) सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउने प्रतीकचिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity includes symbols showing which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally well positioned to carry it out (coloured symbols) or contribute to it (dark blue symbols).1
rows.note: Proposes icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. Preserves footnote marker 1 and the distinction between delivery and contribution.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark green Mine Action icon indicates that Mine Action actors are typically well-placed to deliver an activity.
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यको गाढा हरियो प्रतीकचिह्नले यस कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू कुनै गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark green mine action symbol indicates that actors involved in this work are generally well positioned to carry out an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; preserves the dark-green delivery role.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue Mine Action icon indicates that Mine Action actors are typically well-placed to contribute to or facilitate the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यको गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नले यस कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू कुनै गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान गर्न वा सहजीकरण गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue mine action symbol indicates that actors involved in this work are generally well positioned to contribute to or facilitate the implementation of an activity.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; preserves both contribution and facilitation.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.13, Provide MHPSS through case management services.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा गतिविधि 3.13, ‘केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने’, देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.13, ‘Provide MHPSS through case management services’.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity label T110 verbatim.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icons show that Protection, Child Protection, Gender-Based Violence (GBV), and Mine Action actors are typically well placed to deliver this activity.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) र बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The colored symbols indicate that actors working in the areas of protection, child protection, gender-based violence (GBV) and landmine-related work are generally in a suitable position to carry out this activity.
rows.note: Describes sector delivery roles, not a safeguarding declaration; sector terminology remains unreviewed. Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. The existing wording can describe actors involved in gender-based violence itself rather than actors working in that sector. The revision makes the sector role explicit while retaining the delivery role and its typical, non-mandatory qualification. The back-translation narrows “Mine Action” to “landmine-related work,” potentially excluding actors addressing other explosive ordnance.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, Mine Action actors can train rehabilitation workers and victim assistance case managers on relevant MHPSS topics.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले पुनर्स्थापना कार्यकर्ताहरू र पीडित सहायताका केस व्यवस्थापकहरूलाई सम्बन्धित MHPSS विषयहरूमा तालिम दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, stakeholders in mine action can train rehabilitation workers and victim assistance case managers on relevant MHPSS topics.
rows.note: The supplied rehabilitation-worker and victim-assistance candidates are used, and the source expresses possibility rather than obligation.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icon shows that Health actors are typically well placed to contribute to activity 3.13.
rows.ne: गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नले स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रमा संलग्न पक्षहरू गतिविधि 3.13 मा योगदान गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue symbol shows that actors involved in the health sector are generally well positioned to contribute to activity 3.13.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, by establishing referral pathways and links to general health services.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू स्थापना गरेर र सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवासँग सम्पर्क सम्बन्ध स्थापना गरेर।
rows.bt: For example, by establishing service referral pathways and establishing links with general health services.
rows.note: Referral-linkage guidance drafted using T063; safety review pending. No automatic transfer or additional consent procedure is asserted. The back-translation changes establishing links to maintaining links. The revision explicitly applies establishing to both referral pathways and links with general health services.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 2 presents another example.
rows.ne: चित्र 2 मा अर्को उदाहरण प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: Another example is presented in Figure 2.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: Here the colourful icons show that Health, Education, Protection, Child Protection, and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) actors are typically well placed to deliver activity 3.2, Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.ne: यहाँ रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण र लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV) क्षेत्रमा संलग्न पक्षहरू गतिविधि 3.2, ‘अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने’, सञ्चालन गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Here, the coloured symbols show that actors involved in the health, education, protection, child protection and gender-based violence (GBV) sectors are generally well positioned to carry out activity 3.2, ‘Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills’.
rows.note: Reuses activity label T099 verbatim as an unreviewed candidate. Sector-role guidance remains subject to safety review. Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icons show that Mine Action, Nutrition, Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM), Shelter and Settlements, WASH, and Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well-placed to contribute to it.
rows.ne: गाढा नीलो प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, पोषण, शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM), आश्रय तथा बस्ती, WASH र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जनमा संलग्न पक्षहरू यसमा योगदान गर्न सामान्यतया उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The dark blue symbols show that actors involved in mine action, nutrition, camp coordination and camp management (CCCM), shelter and settlements, WASH, and food security and livelihoods are generally well positioned to contribute to it.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]. WASH is retained without an expansion absent from the source.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, Mine Action actors can ensure that relevant staff are oriented in basic psychosocial support skills and can provide information about the orientations to community leaders.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूले सम्बन्धित कर्मचारीलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण दिइएको सुनिश्चित गर्न सक्छन् र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई ती अभिमुखीकरणबारे जानकारी दिन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, actors involved in mine action can ensure that relevant staff have been given orientation in basic psychosocial support skills and can inform community leaders about those orientations.
rows.note: The phrase [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity candidate T099; no new clinical wording is introduced.

rows.section: How do I find Mine Action content in the MSP?
rows.en: 1 The icons are not intended to be prescriptive, but a guide to who typically does what.
rows.ne: 1 प्रतीकचिह्नहरू कसले के गर्नैपर्छ भनेर तोक्नका लागि होइनन्; ती सामान्यतया कसले के गर्छ भन्ने मार्गदर्शनका लागि हुन्।
rows.bt: 1 The symbols are not for specifying who must do what; they are for guidance on who generally does what.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring term icons = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; retains the non-prescriptive qualification. The back-translation's 'do not necessarily specify' weakens the source's explicit non-prescriptive intent. The revision states that the icons are not intended to prescribe who must do what, while preserving their guidance function.

rows.en: Facilitating the inclusion of survivors of EO related incidents and their caregivers and families in community, cultural, sports and recreational activities (e.g. strengthening survivor networks and facilitating support groups at rehabilitation centres, orthopaedic wards, and health clinics). Including information on injury prevention from EOs in relevant MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: EO सम्बन्धी घटनाका प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू तथा उनीहरूका हेरचाहकर्ता र परिवारलाई समुदायका गतिविधि तथा सांस्कृतिक, खेलकुद र मनोरञ्जनात्मक गतिविधिहरूमा समावेश गराउन सहजीकरण गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै, बाँच्न सफल व्यक्तिहरूका सञ्जाल सुदृढ बनाउने तथा पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रहरू, हाडजोर्नी वार्डहरू र स्वास्थ्य क्लिनिकहरूमा सहयोग समूहहरूलाई सहजीकरण गर्ने)। सम्बन्धित MHPSS गतिविधिहरूमा EOs बाट हुने चोटपटकको रोकथामसम्बन्धी जानकारी समावेश गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Facilitate the inclusion of people affected by EO-related incidents and their caregivers and families in community activities and cultural, sporting and recreational activities (for example, strengthening networks of survivors and facilitating support groups in rehabilitation centres, orthopaedic wards and health clinics). Include information on the prevention of injuries caused by EOs in relevant MHPSS activities.
rows.note: The frozen population label प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू means affected persons and can include indirectly affected people, whereas survivors denotes people who directly experienced and survived the incidents; its use here remains restricted to the source survivors. Repaired orthopaedic treatment rooms to orthopaedic wards. Remaining bt-divergence: the frozen label प्रभावित व्यक्तिहरू means affected persons and does not itself restrict the population to people who directly experienced and survived EO-related incidents, as the source survivors does. The required frozen form is retained. “People affected by EO-related incidents” broadens “survivors of EO related incidents” to potentially include indirectly affected people, rather than restricting inclusion to people who experienced and survived the incidents, together with their caregivers and families.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Mine Action actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Contributing and advocating for the provision of mine action programming in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being. For example, ensuring that EORE messaging in risk education materials and activities does not blame victims and that their experiences aren’t exploited in a manner that can stigmatize them.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई सहयोग पुग्ने गरी बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यका कार्यक्रमहरू सञ्चालन गर्न योगदान दिने र पैरवी गर्ने। उदाहरणका लागि, जोखिमसम्बन्धी शिक्षा सामग्री र गतिविधिहरूमा दिइने EORE सन्देशहरूले पीडितहरूलाई दोष नदिने र उनीहरूलाई कलङ्कित गर्न सक्ने गरी उनीहरूका अनुभवहरूको दुरुपयोग नहुने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
rows.bt: Contribute to and advocate for carrying out mine action programmes in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being. rows.en: Orienting relevant mine action workers on basic psychosocial support, including support with motivation and perseverance in physical therapies, and the identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS services and supports.
rows.ne: बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्यमा संलग्न सम्बन्धित कार्यकर्ताहरूलाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगबारे अभिमुखीकरण दिनुहोस्। यसमा शारीरिक उपचारहरूका क्रममा प्रेरित रहन र प्रयास जारी राख्न सहयोग गर्ने तथा MHPSS सेवा र सहयोग आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका र वयस्कहरूको पहिचान गर्ने र सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्य समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: Give relevant workers involved in mine action an orientation on basic psychosocial support. This includes helping people stay motivated and continue making efforts during physical treatments, and identifying children and adults who may need MHPSS services and support and referring them to relevant services.
rows.note: Physical therapies is treated as a general treatment category rather than a named therapy; the possibility that children and adults may need services and supports is retained.

rows.bt: For support according to your needs, you can contact the MSP assistance desk (Helpdesk) by sending an email to mhpss.msp@gmail.com and mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com.
